unknowns.reason: Intel ARK page gives only max single-core turbo; turbo-ratio-limit MSR not readable (no root); no authoritative per-active-core table retrieved
No authoritative AVX2/AVX-512 frequency table retrieved
lspci -vv hides capability registers for non-root; sysfs speed/width used instead
Not observable from OS without MSR/uncore access
/sys/firmware/acpi/tables files are root-only; only sizes/names compared

limitations: Run was unprivileged (uid 1000): no MSR, SMBIOS table, PCI capability decode, MMIO, or kernel log access.
ACPI analysis used the repository-supplied capture in ./ACPI; hashes were not verified against live firmware tables (root-only), only file names/sizes matched.
Intel ARK page was retrieved as unlabeled markdown; only unambiguous values were used.
Link current state is a point-in-time observation and may reflect link power management.
No stress/workload tests were run; no target policy was changed.
